name: smwsprites-super-mario-maker-p-switch
title: Super Mario Maker: P-Switch
description:
This is a remake of the p-switch sprite from Super Mario Maker. These p-switches essentially act as a sort-of carryable platform that can disappear after a short period of time.
Additionally you can also make changes to some of the interactions and physics of this sprite.

Note: Separate graphics are used for the p-switches so that you can tell the difference between the vanilla version and the ones from Mario Maker.
